derivation: middle voice from a compound of G1722 (ἐν) and G3775 (οὖς);
def: to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen

occurrences.text: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, Ye men of Judea, and all ye that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words:
